changes.rationale: Plan update is linked to explicit observations; conclusions remain provisional.

next_actions: Verify the learning service with an owner-provisioned institutional pilot, approved data policy and restart exercise.
Retest run-bound retrieval on a second independently authored corpus. Score supported answers, appropriate clarification, abstention and citation bytes.
Test the training-parent planner with distinct versioned coder adapters. Record measured calls and cost, and use a fresh holdout to decide whether any proposal improves behavior.
Evaluate an additional instrument dataset with documented unit conventions. Recheck missing values and timestamp precision across scientific data interchange.

Compare multiple probe rows against the single-row rule with nine total measurements. Freeze the estimator, mirrored comparator triangulations, and unseen slopes and locations before scoring. Require gains in both tilt directions before CAD pilot consideration.
